title: "Analyzing US Births and Basketball Recruits"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false

---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")

tibble(
  column_name = names(births),
  type = map_chr(births, \(column) paste(class(column), collapse = ", ")),
  example_values = map_chr(
    births,
    \(column) paste(head(column, 3), collapse = ", ")
  )
)
```

```{r}
summary(select(births, births, year))
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- births |>
  mutate(
    day_of_week = factor(
      day_of_week,
      levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
births_by_calendar_position <- births |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(
    average_births = mean(births),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

births_by_calendar_position |>
  mutate(
    month = factor(month, levels = 12:1, labels = month.name[12:1])
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1, 31, by = 5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Mean births") +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
christmas_data <- births |>
  filter(month == 12, date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 25, 27:30)) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    christmas_births = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    baseline_births = mean(births[date_of_month != 25]),
    pct_of_baseline =
      100 * christmas_births / baseline_births,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_data
```

```{r}
summary(christmas_data)
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_data, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(
  births ~ year + month + day_of_week,
  data = births_tibble
)

summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = 100 * residuals(births_model) / mean(births))

str(births_adjusted)
```

```{r}
calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))
  ) |>
  arrange(calendar_date)

calendar_resid
```

```{r}
holiday_dates <- tibble(
  calendar_date = as.Date(c("2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-11-22", "2001-12-25")),
  holiday = c(
    "New Year's Day",
    "Independence Day",
    "Thanksgiving Day",
    "Christmas Day"
  )
)

calendar_resid |>
  ggplot(aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_text(
    data = left_join(holiday_dates, calendar_resid, by = "calendar_date"),
    aes(label = holiday),
    vjust = -0.6,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Calendar date",
    y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean birth count)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
